name: dpcmopt
comment: MATLAB dpcmopt: DPCM parameter optimiser. Uses Levinson-Durbin on biased autocorrelation (denominator N-i, MATLAB convention) to estimate predictor; then lloyds() on prediction residual for codebook+partition. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on deterministic training (sin + linear ramp) for predictor and codebook/partition outputs. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship dpcmopt in core; reports N/A.
